bibl.title: A List of People: P.Vindob. G 27259
bibl.seg: Lucas Faessen, A List of People: P.Vindob. G 27259.
bibl.note: Remains of two columns of an official list of people. The list seems to be ordered by family and contains a mixture of Greek and Egyptian names. Arsinoite nome (?), ca. 150-200 CE.
